title: UNDER 90 CHARS

data.label: Portfolio Volatility
data.evidence: A 2024 survey by investors holding a mix of asset classes, including precious metals, experienced a 15% lower portfolio volatility compared to those solely invested in stocks.

data.label: Custodian Fees Range
data.evidence: Custodian fees can vary significantly, with annual maintenance fees ranging from $50 to $200.

data.label: 2024 Contribution Limit
data.evidence: The IRS allows you to contribute up to $7,000 in 2024 (or $8,000 if you’re age 50 or older).

data.label: Silver Purity
data.evidence: When purchasing, consider the purity of the silver (typically 99.9% or .999 fine).

narration: Investors holding a mix of asset classes, including precious metals, experienced a 15% lower portfolio volatility compared to those solely invested in stocks. Custodian fees can range from $50 to $200 annually, and the IRS allows for annual contributions of up to $7,000 for those under 50 and $8,000 for those 50 and over.
